drivingQuestion: Are Ila's three added features blemishes?
outcomeNote: the later court accepted Ila's three blemishes

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נִשְׁבַּר עֶצֶם יָדוֹ וְעֶצֶם רַגְלוֹ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִיכָּר. מוּמִין אֵלּוּ מָנָה אִילָא בְּיַבְנֶה, וְהוֹדוּ לוֹ חֲכָמִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Additional blemishes that permit the slaughter of the firstborn include those where «the bone of its foreleg or the bone of its hind leg was broken, even though it is not conspicuous.» With regard to «these blemishes» listed in this chapter, «Ila,» who was expert in blemishes of the firstborn, «enumerated» them «in Yavne, and the Sages deferred to his» expertise.

segments.he: וְעוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה הוֹסִיף, אָמְרוּ לוֹ: לֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶת אֵלּוּ. שֶׁגַּלְגַּל עֵינוֹ עָגוֹל כְּשֶׁל אָדָם, וּפִיו דּוֹמֶה כְּשֶׁל חֲזִיר, וְשֶׁנִּיטַּל רוֹב הַמְדַבֵּר בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ. בֵּית דִּין שֶׁל אַחֲרֵיהֶן אָמְרוּ: הֲרֵי זֶה מוּם.
segments.en: «And» Ila «added three additional» blemishes, and the Sages «said to him: We did not hear» about «those.» Ila added: An animal «whose eye is round like» that «of a person, or whose mouth is similar to» that «of a pig, or where most of» the segment of «its tongue» corresponding to the segment that facilitates «speech» in the tongue of a person «was removed. The court that followed them said» with regard to each of those three blemishes: «That is a blemish» that enables the slaughter of the firstborn.
